# homebrew-mixxx

Homebrew tap for the **xetk Mixxx fork** (accessibility-focused build).

```sh
brew tap XeTK/mixxx
brew install --cask mixxx-fork   # not published yet, see Status
```

## Status

**No cask is published yet.** The cask will be generated by the update-feed CI from
the signed manifest at <https://mixxx.xetk.co.uk/updates/latest.json> once the first
complete feed (Linux, Windows and macOS installers) is published. Until then
`brew tap` works but there is nothing to install.

Notes for when it lands:

- The cask is named `mixxx-fork` because `mixxx` is taken by the official cask.
- The macOS build is **ad-hoc signed and not notarized**, and arm64 only (macOS 11+).
  If Gatekeeper blocks it, right-click the app and choose Open.
- Installers are downloaded from `mixxx.xetk.co.uk` (public), not from this repo.

## Where this lives

The source of truth is <https://gitea.xetk.co.uk/xetk/homebrew-mixxx>. This GitHub repo is
a read-only mirror, updated by `.gitea/workflows/mirror-to-github.yml` on every push to
`main`, so that `brew tap` works anonymously. Do not push here directly: the next
mirror run force-overwrites it.

## Standards

Follows [engineering-standards](https://gitea.xetk.co.uk/xetk/engineering-standards) **v1**, profiles: stack-defaults, homelab.

Deviations are recorded in [`docs/decisions/`](docs/decisions/).
